name: hermes_scorer_rerank_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: hermes_scorer_rerank_20261107 — the watchlist rank drifted away from the scores it claims to
order. DB retest 2026-11-07 12:20 ET found the 11-07 10:15 ET run (an event-tier rescore of 454 names)
had corr(hermes_rank, hermes_composite_score) -0.025, ranks up to 4013 on a ~1,044-item list, and 39
scored rows holding a NULL rank; the 12:00 full run read -0.949. Two causes in
scripts/hermes_watchlist_scorer.py: a partial run ranked only the rows it had just scored (enumerate
1..N) and left every other row holding the rank of an older, larger list, and off-hours it froze
hermes_rank altogether (mode '...-frozen-ranks') so a rescored name kept the rank of its previous score.
The gate pins the contract: after any rescore a name's rank is its position in the WHOLE scoreable
list (this run's scores overlaid on the stored ones), a scored row never keeps a NULL rank and a rank
that no longer orders anything is cleared, the universe is validated symbols only
(symbol_profiles or a portfolio holding — symbol_validation.gate_watchlist_symbol, so headline words
like OVER/WITH are reported as excluded rather than scored), the history row records the rank the list
actually holds after the rerank (never an in-batch counter), and one unwritable row loses only its own
rank write — a symbol whose score write failed is not ranked at all.
Hermetic: fake connection/cursor; no DB, no network, no model.
